title: More Joe Williams arrangements, including "In the Beginning God"
summary: Jones cannot list the 150 arrangements he did for Joe Williams, but recalls the blues with Thad Jones's band and "In the Beginning God".

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: You were -- I think we got off on Gordon and his films, from Joe Williams, doing, 'Don't Misunderstand.' I was asking you what other tunes you had arranged for Joe.
Oh, gobs of them. At least 150 that I can't think of.
Last night what else did he do?

'Don't Misunderstand,' and -- there was a blues thing. He recorded it with Thad Jones's band, because a lot of the scores that I did Thad and Mel did. Oh, it was a blues. Gee whiz, I can't even think of that now. You know, when you get -- Pat, when you get piles of music it's hard to remember.
Did you say earlier that you did an arrangement on, 'In the Beginning God,' for Joe?
That's from Duke's first Sacred Concert.
